design: Five preselected four-ply opening positions, paired colors; three isolated pair jobs in parallel. Base engine=weak (stockfish: 5000 nodes, MultiPV=3; weak: depth-1 material+PST, top-3). Shortlist margin=30. Selector=random. All ten games are new.

analysis.interpretation: Exploratory only: five fixed opening pairs, selector=random. Ten games cannot separate small strength differences; compare per-decision referee scores across arms.
